sheets.title: COVER SHEET
sheets.reading_notes: Cover sheet with location map (aerial photo showing building near Northampton Blvd / First Colonial Rd / Pleasant House Rd area, Virginia Beach VA). Drawing index lists 10 sheets: G-001, A-001, AD101, A-101, A-102, A-501, P-101, A-501[sic — likely second A sheet or a typo], M-501, E-101. BFA logo (Bowman Foster & Associates, Inc.) in upper right; Hampton Roads & Washington Metro Area listed. Virginia PE seal dated 03/03/2022 visible. Project No. 22-012 in title block. CONTRACT NO. field is blank. This PDF contains only 6 of the 10 indexed sheets.

sheets.title: LEGEND, ABBREVIATIONS AND GENERAL NOTES
sheets.reading_notes: Materials legend (section symbols for wood-rough, wood blocking, plywood, aluminum, gypsum board, batt/loose fill insulation, acoustical tile ceiling). 14 general construction notes covering: disposal of removed items, all materials new, wood blocking/steel continuous, verify field conditions, demolition of MEP not to include plumbing/mechanical/electrical (refer to separate drawings), dimensions for new work to face of stud/masonry, contractor study docs and report errors, protect adjoining spaces, floor patching to manufacturer tolerances, temporary supports for ceiling-mounted items, new walls to transition seamlessly, patch existing GWB, seal exterior penetrations, temporary shoring for demolition. Drawn by Jill, Checked by ROW, Project Engineer WJW.

sheets.title: FLOOR PLANS – DEMOLITION
sheets.reading_notes: First floor demolition plan (1/8"=1'-0"): existing floor to remain; shows removal areas with dashed lines; plumbing fixtures shown (likely existing to be removed or capped). Second floor demolition plan (1/8"=1'-0"): second floor existing skylights to be covered per owner requirements; remove existing wall complete. Three demolition notes on sheet. Building footprint shows an irregular plan on first floor; second floor appears to be a smaller footprint (partial second floor or mezzanine-like arrangement). Three numbered demolition notes on this sheet.

sheets.title: FLOOR PLANS AND ENLARGED FLOOR PLAN – NEW WORK
sheets.reading_notes: Four plans on this sheet: (1) First Floor – New Work (1/8"=1'-0"): first floor existing to remain per construction note 1; minor coordination items. (2) Second Floor – New Work (1/8"=1'-0"): shows new partition layout on second floor. (3) Second Floor Enlarged Plan – New Work (3/4"=1'-0"): uni-sex toilet room, approx 9'-2" wide, with ADA-compliant layout; toilet, lavatory, grab bars, accessories (paper towel dispenser, soap dispenser, sanitary napkin dispenser, waste paper dispenser per construction notes 6-10). (4) Second Floor Restroom Ceiling Plan – New Work (1/8"=1'-0"): 2'x2' drop-in ceiling grid, exhaust fan noted (refer to Mechanical). Construction notes on sheet specify: first floor existing to remain; 2'x2' drop-in ceiling grid; exhaust fan (refer to mechanical); lighting fixture (refer to electrical); stainless steel accessories (SS paper towel, soap dispenser, grab bars, sanitary napkin, waste paper).

sheets.title: ENLARGED FLOOR PLANS
sheets.reading_notes: Two enlarged plans: (1) Enlarged Floor Plan – New Work (3/4"=1'-0"): bar area with partition wall 4'-0" tall, knee wall with counter top 44" tall; 12"x12" bar sink and 3-compartment sink per construction notes 1 and 2; attic space labeled above. (2) Enlarged Floor Plan – New Work (second plan, 3/4"=1'-0"): knee wall with counter top 44" tall; similar bar counter configuration in a different bay. Both plans reference attic above. Sheet labeled 'ENLARGED FLOOR PLANS' in title. The bar sinks and 3-compartment sink confirm food/beverage service scope.

sheets.title: DETAILS, ELEVATIONS AND WALL SECTION
sheets.reading_notes: Three items on this sheet: (1) Restroom Clearance Details (no scale): ADA clearance layouts showing 54" min, 42" min, 36" min, 60" floor space dimensions for toilet, lavatory, and grab bar configurations per ADA. (2) Wall Section (no scale, referenced from A-101 detail 2): 6" metal studs @ 16" O.C. with (1) layer 5/8" gypsum board, 6" sound/acoustical batt insulation; slotted deflection track assembly at top; runner track and resilient base/floor per owner at bottom. (3) Two Elevations (no scale, A3 and A4 from A-101): restroom interior elevations showing tile wall at 8" height, toilet paper holder, grab bars. 6" metal studs @ 16" O.C. w/ acoustical batt insulation in wall section.
